paragraphs: Autonomous-ish management of one Yahoo fantasy basketball team (league 44495, 12-team head-to-head 9-category, 2026-27, third-round-reversal draft). It is a hybrid: a deterministic Python quant engine (the fantasy CLI: projections, valuation, draft optimizer, simulation) used as tools by Claude Code agents that orchestrate, drive Yahoo in the browser, verify, and keep an audit trail; Supabase Postgres holds durable state; a Next.js dashboard on Vercel shows it (; fallback , Vercel login required). Agents never re-derive valuations; they run the tools and interpret the JSON.

Basketball primer for quants: H2H 9-cat means each week you play one opponent and win or lose each of 9 categories (FG%, FT%, 3PM, PTS, REB, AST, STL, BLK, TO; lower TO is better). Win 5 of 9 to win the week. FG%/FT% are ratios, so they are modeled from makes and attempts, never averaged percentages.
